[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: 5 Continent invoice reconciliation + 2023 comparison (raw machine execution)
  
  GitHub evidence (PR or commit):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1522
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1523

  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1528
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1544
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1545
  
  Details:
  Analyzed the 5 Continent Logistics invoice 1026-08 (USD 4,866.33) for the Brazil -> San Francisco cacao shipment against the 2026-08-26 quotation, and against the 2023 counterpart invoice.
  
  What changed / was produced:
  - Built the quote-vs-invoice reconciliation iteratively (v2 through v6 PDFs) under agentic_ai_context/brazil/sources/.
  - Froze the variance bridge: quoted 3,510.60 + freight overage 297.57 + quoted-customs-now-billed 418.53 + wholly-unquoted 639.63 = 4,866.33 billed; total gap 1,355.73; contestable 937.20 (69%).
  - v6 derives each of the three buckets line-item by line-item (quoted rate -> billed -> delta -> source), per the governor's request, so the derivation is auditable.
  - Located and extracted the 2023 counterpart invoice (Seacoast Logistics #102000607-1, USD 521.03, same SSA->SFO lane, same forwarder principal Graziela Vedana) plus the full 2023 cost stack (Omega numerario R$4,000; Leite Express CT-e R$864.15; Menzies SFO handling USD 198.50).
  - Ran arithmetic self-checks in-script before each render (freight table sums, invoice total, each bucket, the bridge, the 10% duty-advance identity) and a y-aware PDF column-crossing/word-overlap check to catch table-render collisions.
  
  Why:
  - The governor needs to understand exactly how each disputed figure was derived before replying to the forwarder; the 2023 baseline shows the structural change (2023 = three separate invoices; 2026 = one end-to-end invoice).
  
  GitHub:
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1522
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1523
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1524

  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1528
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1544
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1545
  
  No money moved. No production deploy.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 150.00

- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
